stack.name: mb3r-stack
notes: Generic integration and distribution layer only. No upstream Bering or Sheaft source code is vendored here.
Verified v1.1 bundle for Bering v1.0.0 and Sheaft v1.2.0 artifacts with immutable GHCR image digests.
OpenTelemetry Demo is packaged as an example profile, not as the core contract.
Bering v1.0.0 publishes the 1.3.0 stochastic connectivity contract line with reliability evidence, operation-aware edge identity, endpoint semantic hints, and Sheaft compatibility fixtures.
Sheaft v1.2.0 adds confidence-certified fail-stop sweeps, minimum-boundary gates, and compatible baseline-regression checks without changing the Bering 1.3.0 handoff contracts.
The default analysis remains schema 1.0 and warn-only; an opt-in failure-tolerance overlay enables schema 1.2 for an explicitly selected endpoint and SLO.
Stack verification covers release dry-run, synthetic-otlp live smoke, the opt-in failure-tolerance e2e, pinned-image startup, and adapter e2e checks.
Capacity, queue, routing, and overload-feedback prediction remain outside this bundle claim.
